items.text: Flight PK 418 from Manchester to Lisbon on 14 March was delayed by 3 hours 20 minutes due to a late inbound aircraft and a slot restriction at Lisbon. Passengers were rebooked on the 18:55 departure the same evening. Under Regulation (EC) 261/2004, compensation of €250 per passenger may be payable where the delay exceeds three hours on arrival and no extraordinary circumstances apply. To claim, submit your booking reference and boarding pass via the claims form in your account. Our support chatbot can confirm the delay duration against your booking within seconds, but a written claim still needs to be filed manually.

Meridian Notes 4.2 is now available on all channels. This release adds split-pane editing, a rewritten search index, and fixes a long-standing bug where attachments over 40 MB failed to sync on Windows. Users on 4.0 or earlier should update to 4.1 first before installing 4.2. The automatic updater will roll out in stages over ten days, so not everyone will see it immediately. Full notes and checksums are on the release page.

Holiday rota for the Bristol fulfilment centre, weeks 14–17, is now posted in the staff area. Everyone gets at least one full week off between April and September; swaps must be agreed with your team lead and logged by the 20th of the preceding month. Week 15 is tight because two pickers are on pre-booked leave, so overtime is available at the standard 1.5x rate. If you have questions about your allocation, ask in the ops channel rather than messaging managers directly — the leave bot answers most rota queries instantly.
Orders placed before 2pm on a working day are dispatched the same day; anything after that goes out the next working morning.
Saturday delivery is available in most UK postcodes for an extra £4.95, but not to the Highlands, Islands or Northern Ireland.

We've had a lot of questions this week about the new checkout, so here's a quick summary. The one-page flow replaces the old three-step process, and saved cards now appear automatically for returning customers. A few people have reported that the discount code field doesn't appear until you reach the review panel — that's by design, not a bug. If anything looks wrong on your order, screenshot it and send it to help@fernandpine.co.uk and we'll sort it out.
Returns are free within 30 days of delivery, provided items are unworn and tags are still attached.

Frequently asked questions about the March release of our storefront platform.

Why did my theme break after updating?
Version 5.3 changed how the product grid loads its styles. Themes built before 2022 that hard-code grid widths will need a small CSS adjustment. We've published a patch guide in the developer docs, and the theme checker in your admin panel will flag affected files automatically.

Is the automatic update safe to run during trading hours?
Yes. Updates are applied per storefront and the old version stays live until the new one passes a health check. Most stores see under 30 seconds of cached-page staleness. If you use a custom checkout script, test it on the staging store first.

Where can I see what changed?
The full changelog is below. Note that the deprecated `cart.legacyTotal` field will be removed in 5.4, so update any custom templates that reference it.

```
5.3.0
- new: per-variant inventory sync
- fix: tax rounding on multi-currency orders
- deprecated: cart.legacyTotal
- fix: mobile menu focus trap
```

Our flight to Dublin was cancelled on Friday and the rebooking queue at the desk was enormous, so I used the airline's chat assistant on my phone instead. It found us seats on the Saturday morning flight and emailed the new boarding passes before we'd even left the terminal. Honestly I expected the bot to be useless, but it handled the whole thing in about four minutes. If you're ever stuck at the airport, try the app before you join the queue.
Gift cards can be combined with promotional discounts, but not with each other.
